question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She decided to go on a/an _________ vacation.
solution:
The correct answer is '**recreational**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**recreational**" means relating to or denoting activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.
 
• A recreational vacation is one taken for relaxation and enjoyment.
 
• Options: "**tropic**," "**expandable**," and "**notorious**" do not appropriately describe a type of vacation.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She decided to go on a/an recreational__ vacation.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Tropic (उष्णकटिबंधीय)**: relating to the tropics, the region of Earth surrounding the equator.
 
• **Expandable (विस्तार योग्य)**: able to be expanded or made larger.
 
• **Notorious (बदनाम)**: famous or well known, typically for some bad quality or deed.
